# t_funcs.super_gaussian { #clerq.t_funcs.super_gaussian }

```python
t_funcs.super_gaussian(index)
```

Return a super-Gaussian pulse time function.

A flat-topped pulse with smooth edges, ``ampl * exp(-log(2) *
(2 |t - centre| / fwhm)^(2 order))``. ``order = 1`` is a Gaussian and
large ``order`` approaches a square pulse of width ``fwhm``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                        | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| index  | int    | Integer suffix used to look up parameters in args. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                         |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | TFunc  | Callable ``f(t, args)`` reading ``ampl_{index}``, ``fwhm_{index}``, |
|        | TFunc  | ``centre_{index}`` and ``order_{index}`` from args.                 |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

``fwhm`` is the full width at half maximum for every ``order``.
